description: This 3D model depicts a stylized vanity table rendered in a soft, light blue or teal color. The piece features an ornate mirror frame with elegant scrolling motifs and a decorative shell-like crest at its peak. The table surface is contoured and shows subtle wood grain texture. Below the tabletop are two small drawers, each adorned with a simple, round white knob. The table is supported by four gracefully curved cabriole legs. The overall design evokes a whimsical, antique-inspired aesthetic, reminiscent of Rococo or Baroque styles, presented with a charming, stylized flair.
